license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife unless licensed to practice that profession.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of nursing created in section 12-255-105.

name.quote: "Board" means the state board of nursing created in section 12-255-105.

type.quote: the state board of nursing created in section 12-255-105

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professions and Occupations, Department of Regulatory Agencies
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created a division of professions and occupations in the department of regulatory agencies

degree_required.value: Professional nursing educational program meeting board standards
degree_required.quote: the applicant has completed a professional nursing educational program that meets the standards of the board for approval of educational programs or that is approved by the board

exams.name: Written examination for professional nurses
exams.quote: All nurse applicants, unless eligible for licensure by endorsement, shall be required to pass a written examination approved or prepared by the board

exams.name: Written examination for practical nurses
exams.quote: the board shall hold at least two examinations annually for practical nurses and for professional nurses

interval_years.quote: Licenses, certifications, and registrations issued pursuant to a part or article of this title 12 expire pursuant to a schedule established by the director

required.quote: the board is authorized to require no more than twenty hours of continuing education every two years as a condition of renewal of licenses

hours_per_period.quote: no more than twenty hours of continuing education every two years

period_years.quote: twenty hours of continuing education every two years

available.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of professional nursing in this state to a nurse who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

requirements.value: Applicant must satisfy requirements of occupational credential portability program, including substantially equivalent experience or credentials, or holding current valid license in another jurisdiction with substantially similar scope of practice for at least one year
requirements.quote:
a person duly licensed, certified, registered, or enrolled in good standing in another state or United States territory or through the federal government to practice a particular profession or occupation, or who holds a military occupational specialty, as defined in section
24-4-201
, is, upon application to the division for licensure, certification, registration, or enrollment in that profession or occupation in this state, entitled to the issuance of the applicable license, certification, registration, or enrollment if all of the following apply:
(A)
Submission of satisfactory proof to the regulator, under penalty of perjury, of the applicant's substantially equivalent experience or credentials, as required by the part or article of this title 12 that regulates the applicable profession or occupation or satisfactory proof that the applicant has held for at least one year a current and valid license, certification, registration, or enrollment under a jurisdiction with a scope of practice that is substantially similar to the scope of practice of the profession or occupation as specified in this title 12, and that the applicant has not committed an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under the law governing the applicable profession or occupation

exists.quote: the state board of nursing created in section 12-255-105

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license to engage in the practice of professional nursing to any applicant who

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife unless licensed to practice that profession.

title_protection.quote: only a person who holds a license to practice professional nursing in this state pursuant to this part 1 or who holds a license in another state and is practicing in this state pursuant to section 24-60-3802 may use the title "registered nurse" and its abbreviation, "R.N."

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife unless licensed to practice that profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured or attempted to procure a license by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, misleading omission, or material misstatement of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has procured or attempted to procure a license by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, misleading omission, or material misstatement of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of nursing practice laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this part 1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acted in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has acted in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under his or her care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license to practice nursing or other health-care occupation suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice nursing, practice as a certified midwife, or practice any other health-care occupation suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or aided or knowingly permitted any person to violate any provision of nursing practice laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or has aided or knowingly permitted any person to violate any provision of this part 1 or an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced nursing in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced nursing or as a certified midwife in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards for the practice of nursing or as a certified midwife, as applicable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any order or rule of the board pertaining to nursing practice or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any order or rule of the board pertaining to nursing practice, practice as a certified midwife, or licensure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsified or made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified or in a negligent manner made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Excessively or habitually uses or abuses alcohol, habit-forming drugs, or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Excessively or habitually uses or abuses or has engaged in excessive or habitual use or abuse of alcohol, a habit-forming drug, a controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), or any other drug having similar effects

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to notify the board of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral health condition that affects ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to: Notify the board, as required by section 12-30-108 (1), of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder that affects the person's ability to practice nursing or as a certified midwife with reasonable skill and safety to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated the confidentiality of information or knowledge concerning any patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated the confidentiality of information or knowledge as prescribed by law concerning any patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any conduct that would constitute a crime and relates to employment as a nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any conduct that would constitute a crime as defined in title 18 and that relates to the person's employment as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated abuse of health insurance or advertised services prohibited by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119; or Has advertised through newspapers, magazines, circulars, direct mail, directories, radio, television, or otherwise that the licensee will perform any act prohibited by section 18-13-119 (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and repeatedly ordered or performed demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests, treatment, or services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and repeated ordering or performance, without clinical justification, of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies; The administration, without clinical justification, of treatment that is demonstrably unnecessary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed a fraudulent insurance act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed, distributed, or gave controlled substances to self or family member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed, distributed, or given to himself or herself or a family member any controlled substance as defined in part 2 of article 18 of title 18 or as contained in schedule II of 21 U.S.C. sec. 812

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensed, injected, or prescribed anabolic steroids for hormonal manipulation or performance enhancement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has dispensed, injected, or prescribed an anabolic steroid, as defined in section 18-18-102 (3), for the purpose of hormonal manipulation that is intended to increase muscle mass, strength, or weight without a medical necessity to do so or for the intended purpose of improving performance in any form of exercise, sport, or game

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administered, dispensed, or prescribed habit-forming drugs or controlled substances outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has administered, dispensed, or prescribed any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), other than in the course of legitimate professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been disciplined by another state based upon an act substantially similar to grounds for discipline
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined by another state, territory, or country based upon an act or omission that is defined substantially the same as a ground for discipline pursuant to this subsection (1)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failed to respond in a materially factual and timely manner to a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully fails to respond in a materially factual and timely manner to a complaint issued pursuant to section 12-255-119 (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to accurately complete and submit the designated questionnaire upon renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to accurately complete and submit to the board the designated questionnaire upon renewal of a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Represented oneself as a licensed nurse without proper licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Represents oneself to an individual or to the general public by use of any word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that he or she is a licensed practical or professional nurse unless the person is actually licensed as a practical nurse or professional nurse, respectively

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced nursing during a period when license was suspended, revoked, or placed on inactive status
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife during a period when the person's license has been suspended, revoked, or placed on inactive status

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sold or fraudulently obtained or furnished a license to practice nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sells or fraudulently obtains or furnishes a license to practice as a nurse or certified midwife or aids or abets in such act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report a final criminal conviction to the board within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board, within thirty days after a final conviction, that the person has been convicted of a crime, as defined in title 18

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to maintain professional liability insurance as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain professional liability insurance in accordance with section 12-255-113

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in a sexual act with a patient during or within six months of professional relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months immediately following the termination of the person's professional relationship with the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to notify the board of a final judgment or settlement for malpractice within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to notify the board, in writing and within thirty days after a judgment or settlement is entered, of a final judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction against the licensee for malpractice of nursing or as a certified midwife or a settlement by the licensee in response to charges or allegations of malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report an adverse action taken by another licensing agency within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to report to the board, within thirty days after an adverse action, that an adverse action has been taken against the person by another licensing agency in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report the surrender of a license in another state or jurisdiction within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to report to the board, within thirty days, the surrender of a license or other authorization to practice nursing or as a certified midwife in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diverting or has diverted a controlled substance from place of employment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is diverting or has diverted a controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), or any other drug having similar effects from the person's place of employment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been convicted of an offense under human trafficking statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of an offense under section 18-13-131

definition_quote.value: The delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings. The functions include the initiation and performance of nursing care through health promotion, supportive or restorative care, disease prevention, diagnosis and treatment of human disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, and physical or mental condition using specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill involving the application of biological, physical, social, and behavioral science principles
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings. The functions include the initiation and performance of nursing care through health promotion, supportive or restorative care, disease prevention, diagnosis and treatment of human disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, and physical or mental condition using specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill involving the application of biological, physical, social, and behavioral science principles required for licensure as a professional nurse

value: Evaluating health status through collection and assessment of health data
Providing therapy and treatment that is supportive and restorative
Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions
Referring to medical or community agencies
Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans
methods_authorized.quote: Evaluating health status through the collection and assessment of health data; Health teaching and health counseling; Providing therapy and treatment that is supportive and restorative to life and well-being either directly to the patient or indirectly through consultation with, delegation to, supervision of, or teaching of others; Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions; Referring to medical or community agencies those patients who need further evaluation or treatment; Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans.

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice registered nurses and certified midwives with prescriptive authority may prescribe controlled substances and prescription drugs within their scope of practice
drug_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife may be granted authority to prescribe prescription drugs and controlled substances to provide treatment to clients within the role and population focus of the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife, as applicable.

license_tiers.quote:
"Advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered professional nurse who is licensed to practice pursuant to this part 1, who obtains specialized education or training as provided in section
12-255-111
, and who applies to and is accepted by the board for inclusion in the advanced practice registry established pursuant to section
12-255-111
..."Certified midwife" means an individual who meets the qualifications for practice as a certified midwife, as specified in this part 1 and by the American Midwifery Certification Board, or its successor entity, and who is currently licensed by the board. Only an individual who holds a license to practice as a certified midwife in this state pursuant to this part 1 has the right to use the title "certified midwife" and its abbreviation, "C.M."..."Practical nurse", "trained practical nurse", "licensed vocational nurse", or "licensed practical nurse" means a person who holds a license to practice pursuant to this part 1 as a licensed practical nurse in this state or is licensed in another state and is practicing in this state pursuant to section
24-60-3802
, with the right to use the title "licensed practical nurse" and its abbreviation "L.P.N." or "licensed vocational nurse" and its abbreviation, "L.V.N."..."Registered nurse" or "registered professional nurse" means a professional nurse, and only a person who holds a license to practice professional nursing in this state pursuant to this part 1 or who holds a license in another state and is practicing in this state pursuant to section
24-60-3802
may use the title "registered nurse" and its abbreviation, "R.N."

aprn_role_categories.quote: A registered professional nurse who is included in the advanced practice registry has the right to use the title "advanced practice registered nurse" or, if authorized by the board, to use the title "certified nurse midwife", "clinical nurse specialist", "certified registered nurse anesthetist", or "nurse practitioner". These titles may be abbreviated as "A.P.R.N.", "C.N.M.", "C.N.S.", "C.R.N.A.", or "N.P.", respectively.

value: Licensed health-care provider authorized to practice in the state
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practice of practical nursing" means the performance, under the supervision of a licensed health-care provider authorized to practice in this state, of those services requiring the education, training, and experience

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: "Collaboration" means the act of licensed health-care providers working cooperatively within each licensed health-care provider's scope of practice to formulate and carry out the plan of patient care.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife who obtains prescriptive authority pursuant to this section shall be assigned a specific identifier by the state board of nursing.

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife must obtain seven hundred fifty hours of documented experience in a mutually structured prescribing mentorship either with a physician or with an advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife who has full prescriptive authority

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife who obtains prescriptive authority pursuant to this section shall be assigned a specific identifier by the state board of nursing.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: The board may authorize the following licensees to prescribe controlled substances or prescription drugs, as those terms are defined in section 12-280-103: An advanced practice registered nurse who is listed on the advanced practice registry, who has a license in good standing without disciplinary sanctions issued pursuant to section 12-255-110, and who has fulfilled the requirements of this section and requirements established by the board pursuant to this section; or A certified midwife who has a license issued pursuant to section 12-255-111.5 that is in good standing without disciplinary sanctions and who has fulfilled the requirements of this section and requirements established by the board pursuant to this section.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Initial prescriptions limited to seven-day supply for opioid-naive patients; may include second fill for seven-day supply. Exceptions for chronic pain, cancer pain, post-surgical pain, and palliative/hospice care.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A prescriber shall not prescribe more than a seven-day supply of an opioid to a patient who has not obtained an opioid prescription from that prescriber within the last twelve months and may exercise discretion to include a second fill for a seven-day supply. The limits on initial prescribing do not apply if, in the judgment of the prescriber, the patient: Has chronic pain that typically lasts longer than ninety days or past the time of normal healing, as determined by the prescriber, or following transfer of care from another prescriber who practices the same profession and who prescribed an opioid to the patient; Has been diagnosed with cancer and is experiencing cancer-related pain; Is experiencing post-surgical pain that, because of the nature of the procedure, is expected to last more than fourteen days; or Is undergoing palliative care or hospice care focused on providing the patient with relief from symptoms, pain, and stress resulting from a serious illness in order to improve quality of life

dea_registration_required.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The board shall maintain a registry of all certified nurse aides and a record of all final disciplinary action taken against persons under this article 255. The registry shall conform to all requirements of federal law and regulation.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Prior to a certified nurse aide obtaining authority as a medication aide to administer medications, the certified nurse aide shall meet all applicable requirements as established by rules of the board.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Any licensed practical nurse, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or certified midwife may delegate any task included in the nurse's or certified midwife's licensed scope of practice, subject to the requirements of this section. A licensed practical nurse, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or certified midwife may delegate nursing or certified midwife tasks to licensed, certified, registered, or unlicensed or unregulated assistive personnel.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: To facilitate the licensure of nurses under the "Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact", part 38 of article 60 of title 24

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A license on inactive status shall constitute a single state license issued by Colorado and without multistate licensure privilege pursuant to part 38 of article 60 of title 24.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife must obtain seven hundred fifty hours of documented experience in a mutually structured prescribing mentorship either with a physician or with an advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife who has full prescriptive authority and experience in prescribing medications
